problem_type: Media protocol declarations cannot preserve binary result semantics
symptom: Accepted video completes but content bytes produce assets=[]
direct_cause: Result executor reads every HTTP body as JSON/text; multipart requires a reference file
class_root: HTTP operation has no media response role and unknown video connections inherit a route without evidence
affected_population: All declared asynchronous video results with authenticated content bytes
Undocumented connections without an explicit video protocol

external_sources.purpose: Authenticated binary content is separate from metadata
Multipart creation and Response content contract

invariants: The corrected builtin factory and no-mapping runtime do not infer a video route; external legacy catalog producers are pending
Binary video results never pass through JSON/text buffering
Task identifier survives retrieval errors; retrieval does not submit

door_reduction.why_not: Runtime create and result-query remain separate lifecycle callers; JSON readers remain necessary. The builtin factory has explicit protocol selection, while catalogCommit.draftShapeForKind and relayNativeWireUpgrade still produce legacy defaults outside this task scope and need coordination before this class can be closed.

generality_proof: Response role drives streaming at the shared executor for all declared connections; no vendor or model branch.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Shared bound authentication, timeout and streaming response consumption
Media response stage/kind and multipart declaration validation
Dispatch typed file results before JSON parsing
Stream to private staging and publish only after decode

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All declared result operations use the same executor
Cache hits and restart rebuild converge on executeTaskQuery

recurrence.reason: Any future gateway can return binary content or require multipart without a file
same_class_scan: rg audioResponse multipart result in catalog/providerAdapter/runtime/tasks

prevention.invariant: Declared video file responses flow through bounded stream and verified asset storage
prevention.failure_mode: Reject invalid declarations before POST; retain accepted task on retrieval failure
prevention.strategy: Type the response at the HTTP operation boundary; never sniff routes or retry another POST

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove implicit selection in builtinOpenAiCompatibleDraft and the no-mapping runtime. Explicit mappings remain unchanged. Legacy automatic producers in catalogCommit and relayNativeWireUpgrade are still pending outside this task scope.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Native Fetch/FormData/Node stream and existing decoder; no SDK dependency introduced

migration: Existing explicit mappings unchanged; generated undocumented video drafts have no modes until evidence is supplied.
residual_risks: Real provider, paid run, Windows and independent acceptance remain unverified
Legacy public URL materialization still uses the existing buffered path; the new bounded stream applies to authenticated file responses
The retrieval function accepts AbortSignal, but main IPC and production cancellation callers have not been changed or end-to-end verified
File responses require project identity; the independently owned tryModel entry does not currently supply it
Unified perf driver registration requires a shared infrastructure change outside this task scope
catalogCommit.draftShapeForKind at the video fallback and relayNativeWireUpgrade still call the legacy transport without protocol evidence; routing remediation is incomplete
